card.name: Dictionary entry punctuation and connectors
card.fires_on: Small connecting marks and words inside dictionary-style entries, such as the dash between source labels and the next definition, commas after headwords, and words like 'in' or 'also' within a definition.

modes.label: Dash between entries
modes.description: A dash right after a dictionary source label (Webster's 1913, Century Dictionary) that begins the next definition.
modes.example: GNU Webster's 1913 <<->> n. (Law) A person who

modes.label: Connectors inside definitions
modes.description: A comma or short linking word within a definition or cross-reference.

card.plain: It fires on the small joining marks and words in old dictionary entries, like the dash that starts a new definition.
